mentions.name: gloss
mentions.description: A terminal tool that renders markdown, sources, images, and chess and go (game) records, built for libghostty with fallback support for other terminals. Installable via Homebrew.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://github.com/garlab/gloss | `brew install garlab/tap/gloss`: render markdown, sources, images, chess and go (game) records in the terminal. It's built for libghostty but fallback on other terms.
mentions.author: xinu2020
